description: Initialized research project workspace for 'UAV Computer Vision for Precision Agriculture'

parameters.title: UAV Computer Vision for Precision Agriculture
rqs: RQ1: What is the statistically significant effect of deep learning architectural choices (CNNs vs Transformers) on segmentation accuracy (mIoU/F1) across agricultural UAV datasets?
RQ2: How do edge hardware constraints (Power, TOPS) correlate with real-time inference capabilities (FPS) for UAV crop/weed segmentation models?
